summary: For single-record CSV input with headers disabled, calling headers() before records() consumes the input and caches the first record. The buggy iterator checks done() before returning that cached record, yielding zero rows. The fix moves the completion check after first-record handling, allowing the cached row to be returned. The test added by this fix asserts that one row is collected. Both reversal regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions; no tests or builds were run.
